answer.reason: The verses tell the ark's story through its making, its crossing of Jordan, its capture by the Philistines, and its bringing to Jerusalem and the temple.

clauses.english: was made by Bezaleel of shittim wood overlaid with gold
clauses.quote: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood

clauses.english: was carried before Israel, and the waters of Jordan were cut off before it
clauses.quote: the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD

clauses.english: was taken by the Philistines in battle, and Dagon fell before it at Ashdod
clauses.quote: And the ark of God was taken

clauses.english: was brought up to Jerusalem by David, and Uzzah died for touching it on the way
clauses.quote: God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.

clauses.english: was brought by Solomon into the most holy place of the temple
clauses.quote: the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place

doubts: Several marked verses (such as 1SA 14:18 and 2SA 15:24-29) were not used because they are minor episodes beyond the chief events chosen.
1SA 6:19 is not used; the count of those smitten is uncertain and it is a lesser detail than the chief events.
